name: Semon Rezchikov
biography: is an independent security researcher and synthetic biologist. He masterminded last year’s presentation on the FAST Airport Security System and is a 20 Under 20 Fellow. Over the summer, he’s building flexible bioautomation robots and simulating synthetic morphogenetic multicellular patterning for MIT’s Weiss Lab for Synthetic Biology. In his free time, he can be found playing around with mathematics, reading too many papers, and thinking of ways to mess with the systems around him.
